svg.aria-label: The Demoverse weekly loop, drawn as 8-bit pixel art. Your target list of real ICP accounts seeds the state/world.json ledger. The ledger feeds a deterministic TypeScript engine that runs a weekly advance and emits grounded requests. A Claude Code agent writes the prose. The engine then ingests, lints and reconciles it into Salesforce, Google Drive and Slack, and records the external IDs back on the ledger.
